summary: The collective declaration from the 2023 National Dialogue on Corruption, outlining 9 core principles for a transparent and accountable South African society.
core_principles: Zero Tolerance for Corruption in all forms
Comprehensive protection and support for whistleblowers
Shared responsibility across all sectors of society
Strengthening and ensuring independence of anti-corruption agencies
Ethical leadership in public, private, and civil society sectors
Full implementation of NACS and Zondo Commission recommendations
Proactive prevention through systems, education, and transparent processes
Personal commitment to individual integrity and resisting corruption
stakeholders: Endorsed by participants of the National Dialogue (Government, Business, Civil Society).
